Slam | metadata_id = Metadata/Monsters/DespairBear/DespairBear }} '''Gruthkul, Mother of Despair''' is a [[List of unique monsters|unique monster]] located in the Den of Despair inside [[The Dread Thicket (Act 7)|The Dread Thicket]] in [[Act 7]]. ==Quest== {{Ql|Queen of Despair}} ==Mechanics== Gruthkul uses the following skills: * {{stl|Gruthkul's Despair}} - Debuff applied continuously inside the boss arena. Increases damage taken, reduces [[action speed]] and [[light radius]]. Stacks with each 10% life lost. * '''Roar''' - Channels and fires 5 [[physical]] [[projectile]]s from random positions and adds another projectile per 25% life lost. * '''Slam''' - Gruthkul rears and then slams the ground in front with the forelegs. * '''Upheaval''' - Upheave the ground beneath the character, dealing [[physical]] [[damage over time]]. ** [[Weight of Despair]] - Upheavel creates a ground effect that applies this debuff. Deals [[physical]] [[damage over time]] and reduces [[movement speed]]. {{status | name = Weight of Despair | type = Debuff | description = You are taking Physical Damage over time and have reduced movement speed. }} ===Video=== {{#ev:youtube|B-GF_XLffKw|400}} ==Pantheon powers== Defeating Gruthkul unlocks a minor god power in [[the Pantheon]] screen. This power can be upgraded by defeating a specific map boss and capturing their soul.
